A type of flock-dwelling '''avian''' creature with [[Color/Legends|quicksilver]] [[Limb/Legends|wings]] dwelt on<ref name="NJO Rebirth" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="NJO Rebirth" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]</ref> while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] were talking outside an abandoned Chandrilan [[Unidentified villa|villa]], a flock of the [[Bird/Legends|avians]] was startled by a clap of thunder, which caused them to rise into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] behind Durron.<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The avian appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second volume of the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'', which was itself a part of the series ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''.<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />
